role: Accepted planning override; not source evidence, an executable ruleset, or corrected-runtime proof
scope: Common future configurator interaction policy across model lanes; apply each model own compatibility and lifecycle facts
supersedes: Earlier refusal-versus-replacement UI choices for compatibility conflicts; does not change prohibited combinations, model scope, or factory lifecycle facts
precedence: Apply this policy after the model owner_review. Earlier decision targets, review states, interaction alternatives and expected sequences remain historical wherever their compatibility UI treatment conflicts with this policy. Model-specific constraints, permitted replacement targets, prices and ownership requirements remain authoritative.

compatibility_conflict_card.styling: distinct compatibility-issue styling, not fully inactive
compatibility_conflict_card.activation: Show replacement notice identifying incompatible selections and the changes needed before applying the new selection
compatibility_conflict_card.confirm: Apply the requested choice and disclosed compatible replacement changes

factory_unavailable_card.activation: No selection or charge; show factory-unavailable disclosure

preservation: A clickable conflict card does not permit an invalid combination. Removed offerings and inapplicable model/body/trim offerings are not made available by this policy. Prerequisites are not waived.

direct_dependency_removal.authority: Owner approval in PR #41 follow-up: apply the proposed D84 notice/confirm/cancel solution to analogous unresolved conflict interactions.
direct_dependency_removal.scope: All six lanes; explicit removal of a customer-removable option required or acquired by other selected options or an interior.
direct_dependency_removal.locked_meaning: Cannot commit an invalid parent/child combination. Does not by itself disable a request that can be resolved by disclosed removal of its supporting sources.
direct_dependency_removal.candidate: Honor the requested removal. Remove its independent intent, if any, and the selected dependent sources/supporting roots needed to prevent reacquisition or an unsatisfied requirement. Reconcile unsupported descendants and charges. Preserve unrelated choices, including paint; do not break a condition by arbitrarily changing another endpoint.
direct_dependency_removal.multiple_causes: Account for every live cause and invalidated dependent. Disclose the complete removal set in one transaction; do not remove only one source and silently reacquire the requested option from another.
direct_dependency_removal.confirm: Commit the disclosed candidate atomically. Explicit removal ends independent ownership of the requested option; prior independent intent does not protect it from that request.
direct_dependency_removal.cancel: Preserve the entire previous committed state, including intent, causes, interior and charges.
direct_dependency_removal.revert: Restore the entire previous committed state.
direct_dependency_removal.source_removal_distinction: Removing only a package or dependency trigger retains independently owned children when still valid, according to the accepted lane ownership policy; children without another live cause disappear.
direct_dependency_removal.interior: If the removed option is required by the chosen interior, disclose clearing that leaf and its unsupported causes. Do not choose a replacement leaf; missing required interior remains incomplete and cannot submit.
direct_dependency_removal.limits: Does not make factory-unavailable, inapplicable or standard-only informational content customer-removable. Does not waive mandatory configuration equipment, invent replacement products, package credits or prices, or authorize a new alternative where no valid removal transaction exists.

grand_sport_d84.ownership: Same result with dependency-only or prior independent D84. Confirmation removes independent D84 intent if present; revert restores its original ownership.

stingray.preserved_constraints: PCX cannot retain incompatible paid accessory wheels in place of included wheels. The notice must disclose the compatible replacement, not permit that prohibited package combination or invent a package credit.

grand_sport.preserved_constraints: Apply full model-specific VPW/VPO exclusions in both directions; replace the refusal exception with the common notice/confirm/cancel interaction.

grand_sport_x.preserved_constraints: Apply full Grand Sport X VPW/VPO exclusions in both directions; replace the refusal exception with the common notice/confirm/cancel interaction. Do not import Grand Sport offering identities.

z06.preserved_constraints: Apply full Z06 stripe/package/badge conflicts in both directions. Stripes and badges both use the common notice; no incompatible combination is permitted.

authorized_alternatives: Require switch to PDD with notice before accepting Z07
pdb_z07_interaction.chosen_ui_alternative: Require switch to PDD with notice before accepting Z07
pdb_z07_interaction.cancel: Preserve the prior valid build and charges; do not silently substitute a package

zr1.preserved_constraints: Retain ZR1 graphic exclusion sets and factory lifecycle restrictions; this shared policy does not transfer ZR1 equipment or displaced-cover ownership to another model.

zr1x.preserved_constraints: Apply this common interaction policy to ZR1X facts only. ZR1X-D01 through D09 reconcile prior approvals under the September 13 owner clarification; their authority and source applicability are recorded in zr1x-owner-decisions.json. J59 remains standard; ZTK uses FEZ/XFS/TOM. Preserve ZR1X rates and equipment rather than copying another model.

undiscovered_model_boundary: All six model handoffs are retained. ZR1X decisions are reconciled with prior owner approvals; the coherent six-model review remains a separate next task. This policy does not authorize implementation.
